transcript: When everything feels urgent... um, I just try to do everything as fast as I can. In customer success there are always a lot of tickets and emails, and customers want answers quickly, so I try to reply to everyone the same day if possible. Usually I go from the top of my inbox, the oldest first, because that's fair, first come first served. If my manager tells me something is important then I do that one first of course. Sometimes a customer is very angry and they call many times, so I help that customer first so they calm down. Staying calm is very important, if you panic you make mistakes. I also sometimes stay a bit late to finish everything, I don't mind, I like to leave with an empty inbox. I don't really use a special method or tool, I just keep going until it's done. Maybe I could use a to-do list more, my friend uses one and she says it helps. But generally if you work hard and stay positive, you can handle it. That's my approach, really.
